wizard.heading: Wizard — {title}
wizard.step1Help: Search by name, national ID, or mobile number, then pick the subscriber from the list. If you only see a line number without a full subscriber profile, link it in the subscriber registry first or choose a profile-backed record before continuing.
wizard.multiProfileSameParty: Several subscriber profiles are linked to the same CRM customer (multi-line / corporate). Pick the profile that should drive this operation; each row is one profile.
wizard.secondaryRequiredHint: Take-over requires selecting the new subscriber (second party) from the search results before you continue.
wizard.targetOfferRequiredHint: Pick the target plan or offer from the list — required for plan-change requests.

migrationOffers.placeholder: — Select a catalog offer (filtered by line type) —
migrationOffers.lineTypeHint: Subscriber line type used for filtering: {type}
migrationOffers.selectSubscriberFirst: Pick the subscriber from search results first to load compatible offers.
migrationOffers.emptyCatalog: No catalog offers match this line type — use “Other” with an approved description or review the product catalog.
migrationOffers.otherPh: Type the plan name as in your catalogue…
migrationOffers.otherRequiredHint: When you choose “Other”, enter a clear description of the target plan.

wizard.activateIccidHint: 19-digit ICCID from the SIM kit — required for activation.
wizard.activateMsisdnRequired: Select an available MSISDN from the search results before continuing.
wizard.iccidRequired: Enter the 19-digit SIM ICCID for activation.
wizard.notesPh: Example: ticket id, branch name, anything the next person should know…
wizard.step2Help: Step 1: press “Save request” to get a reference number. Step 2: after you have filed the ID or required document following your local procedure, press “Confirm document on file” so the system knows the paperwork is complete. Step 3: watch the table below; back-office colleagues complete billing confirmation when the request is ready.
wizard.huaweiHint: Plan-change requests do not collect top-ups or extra charges on this screen; after internal review the request is sent to billing to apply the new plan.
wizard.uploadBtnTakeOver: Upload ID and send for review
wizard.uploaded: Document recorded. You can follow the request in the table until review and confirmation are finished.
wizard.step3c: For day-to-day work use the “Telecom requests” table on this page; “Confirm execution” runs for authorised roles on the first request that is ready for review.
